Import: `import { Toggle, ToggleGroup } from "@tundralibs/ui/toggle"`

Rendered in every variant on the catalogue (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/index.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `Toggle`

```ts
Toggle(props: ToggleProps): Html
```

A pressed-state button (`aria-pressed`): bold, italic, grid or list
view. Nothing submits by itself; give it `name` + `value` and a hidden
input mirrors the pressed state into the form. Works without the
script as a plain button that does nothing — pair it with your own
behaviour or use it inside a `ToggleGroup`.

### `ToggleGroup`

```ts
ToggleGroup(props: ToggleGroupProps): Html
```

Toggles joined edge to edge; Left/Right move focus between them. A
subtle group (the default) sits on one sunken tray; an outline group
is a row of bordered buttons sharing their edges.

## Types

### `ToggleSize`

- `"sm"`
- `"md"`

### `ToggleVariant`

`subtle` sits on the sunken ground; `outline` has a border like `btn--outline`.

- `"subtle"`
- `"outline"`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### Grid or list view

`exclusive` makes the group radio-like; the pressed toggle's hidden input submits `view=grid`.

```ts
ToggleGroup({
  id: "view",
  label: "View",
  exclusive: true,
  items: [
    {
      label: "Grid",
      icon: Icon("dashboard", { size: 16 }),
      iconOnly: true,
      pressed: true,
      name: "view",
      value: "grid",
    },
    { label: "List", icon: Icon("list", { size: 16 }), iconOnly: true, name: "view", value: "list" },
  ],
})
```

```html
<div class="toggle-group toggle-group--subtle" id="view" role="group" aria-label="View" data-toggle-group="" data-toggle-exclusive="">
  <button type="button" class="toggle toggle--icon" aria-pressed="true" data-toggle-button="" data-toggle-value="grid" data-toggle-name="view">
    <span class="toggle__icon" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg width="16" height="16" width="2" width="7" height="7" width="7" height="7" width="7" height="7" width="7" height="7" …>…</svg>
    </span>
    <span class="sr-only">Grid</span>
    <input type="hidden" name="view" value="grid" data-toggle-mirror>
  </button>
  <button type="button" class="toggle toggle--icon" aria-pressed="false" data-toggle-button="" data-toggle-value="list" data-toggle-name="view">
    <span class="toggle__icon" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg width="16" height="16" width="2" …>…</svg>
    </span>
    <span class="sr-only">List</span>
    <input type="hidden" name="view" value="list" data-toggle-mirror disabled>
  </button>
</div>
```

### A single toggle with a visible label

Listen for `toggle:change` (`detail.pressed`) to react without a form.

```ts
Toggle({ id: "watch", label: "Watching", icon: Icon("eye", { size: 16 }), variant: "outline", pressed: true })
```

```html
<button type="button" class="toggle toggle--outline" id="watch" aria-pressed="true" data-toggle-button="">
  <span class="toggle__icon" aria-hidden="true">
    <svg width="16" height="16" width="2" …>…</svg>
  </span>
  <span class="toggle__label">Watching</span>
</button>
```

## CSS hooks

Classes defined by `components/toggle/toggle.css` — structural, token-driven; override from an unlayered stylesheet (see [Theming](../UI-Theming.md)):

`.btn-group`, `.toggle`, `.toggle--icon`, `.toggle--outline`, `.toggle--sm`, `.toggle-group`, `.toggle-group--subtle`, `.toggle__icon`

## Behaviour

`components/toggle/toggle.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-toggle-button`, `data-toggle-exclusive`, `data-toggle-group`, `data-toggle-mirror`, `data-toggle-value`.

Events: `toggle:change`.
